description: Writing down the Wren & Barley design system with Studio Code, so the site preview's Design system view has a conversation beside it.
title: Write down the design system

turns.prompt: Can you write down the design system for the site, so every page we add stays on brand?
replies: I'll start from the theme's colors and type.

args.content:
---
name: Wren & Barley
description: Bakery and café on Mill Lane
colors:
  primary: "#B2583C"
  background: "#FFFFFF"
  text: "#31261D"
…

replies: I wrote **DESIGN.md** from the theme: terracotta (#B2583C) for actions and the header, deep brown (#31261D) for text, warm creams and taupes as accents, and Literata for everything, set in spaced capitals for headings. Open **Design system** in the preview to see it laid out.

turns.prompt: Nice. Are the buttons in it too? They should stay flat and square.

details.diff:
@@ -38,2 +38,7 @@
 components:
+  button-primary:
+    backgroundColor: "{colors.primary}"
+    textColor: "{colors.background}"
+    rounded: 0
+    padding: 0.9rem 1.6rem

replies: Added them: primary buttons are terracotta with white text, square corners and no shadow, the same as the **Order** button on the site.

turns.prompt: Does the theme still match the doc?
replies: Yes. Every color, font and size in theme.json matches DESIGN.md, and the Design system view says so at the top: **theme.json matches DESIGN.md**.
